# Frostpine Ski Rentals - equipment log

One row per rental contract. The booking system retry wrote some contracts to the export twice; rental_id identifies the contract and renter_id identifies the customer.

Fit bench
- Boot shells rack by size on the wall.
- The heat gun for moldings lives in the drawer.
- Helmet liners go in the wash bin nightly.
